body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-05-27 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "So next year has to be 9%, yes. No doubt about it." Metric: Consolidated EBITDA margin. Target: >=9%. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Jan-26: 9-10% 'I can always say FY28'. May-26: no margin guidance; double-digit 'maybe FY29'. Aug-26: no double digit in FY27. Nov-26: FY28 'whether we'll achieve 7% or 8% or 9% is difficult to say'. H1FY27 EBITDA ~5.4% (screener 291+271 / 10,492). The FY27 9% was never referred to again.
